title: RuntimePatternBranches
$comment: A nested composition, so the static evaluator refuses it and the schema is compiled to the runtime one. The only keyword here that needs an ECMA-262 engine is `pattern` on a node -- patternProperties is in runtime_patternprops_branches.json, so that each of the two spellings is guarded on its own rather than by whichever of them the file happens to carry.
